2. Present C-528 application is filed with the
prayer to set-aside/quash the charge sheet dated
19.12.2025, cognizance/summoning order dated
23.12.2025 and the entire proceedings of Special
Sessions Trial No.94 of 2025, pending in the
Court of learned Special Judge (POCSO)/F.T.C./
Additional Sessions Judge, Haldwani, District
Nainital.
3. Facts of the case, in brief, are that the
mother of the victim lodged a missing report
stating therein that the victim, aged about 161⁄2
years at the relevant time, had left her house on
03.06.2025 at about 02:00 p.m. for the house of
her elder sister situated at Gorapadaav,
Hathikhal, but had not returned home. It is
stated that the victim returned home on the
following day. Pursuant to the report lodged by
the complainant, the matter was investigated by
the Investigating Officer, who, upon completion of
the investigation, submitted a charge-sheet
against the applicant. Thereafter, the learned
court concerned took cognizance of the offences
and summoned the applicant to face trial. Hence,
the present Criminal Miscellaneous Application.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits

2026:UHC:9537
that the statements of the victim and the
complainant, who is the mother of the victim,
were recorded before the learned Court
concerned, and both have stated that the victim
had gone to the house of her elder sister. It is
further submitted that the victim and the
applicant have solemnized their marriage under
the provisions of the Special Marriage Act, 1954,
on 10.08.2024, and a copy of the marriage
certificate has been placed on record. Learned
counsel further submits that the victim and the
other material witnesses have not supported the
prosecution case. In view of the aforesaid facts
and circumstances, it is contended that the
allegations, as reflected in the material available
on record, do not warrant the continuation of the
criminal proceedings against the applicant and
that such continuation would serve no fruitful
purpose and would amount to an abuse of the
process of law. Accordingly, a prayer has been
made to quash the impugned charge-sheet,
cognizance/summoning order and the entire
consequential proceedings.
5. Per contra, learned State Counsel has
vehemently opposed the present Criminal
Miscellaneous Application and submitted that the
matter pertains to an offence under the POCSO
Act and, therefore, the proceedings ought not to
be quashed merely on the basis of the
relationship between the applicant and the victim
or their subsequent marriage.
6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the material available on record. The
allegations primarily relate to the victim having
left her house on 03.06.2025 and her return on
the following day. As submitted by learned
counsel for the applicant, the victim and her
mother, in their statements recorded before the
learned Court concerned, have stated that the
victim had gone to the house of her elder sister. It
is further brought to the notice of this Court that
the victim and the applicant have solemnized
their marriage under the Special Marriage Act,
1954, and a copy of the marriage certificate has
been placed on record. Learned counsel has also
submitted that the victim and the other material
witnesses have not supported the prosecution
case.
7. In the facts and circumstances of the

UKHC010186552026
2026:UHC:9537
present case, the statements of the victim and the
complainant, together with the other material
collected during the investigation, do not disclose
the essential ingredients of the offences alleged
against the applicant and since the victim have
solemnized her marriage with the applicant after
attaining the marriageable age, therefore, the
continuation of the proceedings would not be
justified merely because a charge-sheet has been
submitted and cognizance has been taken.
8. Consequently, the present Criminal
Miscellaneous Application is allowed and the
entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.
94 of 2025, pending before the Court of learned
Special Judge (POCSO)/F.T.C./Additional
Sessions Judge, Haldwani, District Nainital, are
hereby quashed.
